# The Signal 24

> The Signal 24 is a public-interest newsroom that holds India's governments, courts, commissions and agencies to their own records on reservation and representation. Every claim is linked to its source: judgments, gazette notifications, commission reports, parliamentary records and official data. It publishes in English (https://thesignal24.com/) and Hindi (https://thesignal24.com/hi).

Canonical site: https://thesignal24.com · Hindi edition: https://thesignal24.com/hi

How to read and cite this site:

- Every record names its source, its date and a verification status: unverified, source-linked or verified. Cite the Signal 24 record and the primary source it links to.
- Reporting and opinion are separate. Opinion pieces are labelled "Opinion" ("राय" in Hindi), carry a byline, and must be cited as the publication's opinion, not as reporting.
- The Accountability Watch on the front page lists specific questions the state has not answered, each tied to a public source and a "last checked" date. Treat it as current only as of that date.
- Items on the live desk are unreviewed outside leads, not Signal 24 reporting. Community noticeboard posts are participant contributions, not Signal 24 reporting.
- A political demand, a litigant's argument, an interim order and a final judgment are different things. Records mark legal status as current, proposed, challenged, stayed or struck down.
- Hindi pages are translations of the same records. Where a Hindi edition is not ready, the page says so and shows the English text.
- The Signal 24 criticises institutions, office-holders and decisions. It does not rank or target communities.

## Start here

- [Front page](https://thesignal24.com/): Accountability Watch, the policy ledger and the latest sourced records.
- [Policy ledger](https://thesignal24.com/policies): Every recorded change in reservation policy, with the old rule, the new rule, the legal basis, the court status and the primary sources.
- [Archive](https://thesignal24.com/archive): Every published record: court rulings, policy changes, historical documents and state records.
- [Timeline](https://thesignal24.com/timeline): A dated index of records, with effective dates, publication dates and outside leads labelled separately.
- [Opinion](https://thesignal24.com/opinion): Signed, labelled opinion from the editorial board, argued from the record.

## Topics

- [Topics](https://thesignal24.com/topics): Records grouped by subject: courts, states, history, data and ground reports.
- [Open-category competition](https://thesignal24.com/topics/open-category-competition): Open-category competition, UGC equity rules and EWS eligibility: what the law says, what was claimed, and what the courts decided.

## Evidence and data

- [Events and evidence](https://thesignal24.com/events): Events with explicitly linked articles and source documents.
- [Data room](https://thesignal24.com/data): Verified data records, and an account of the data the state has collected but not released.

## About and standards

- [About](https://thesignal24.com/about): Who the publication answers to, what it investigates, and what it refuses to do.
- [Editorial standards](https://thesignal24.com/editorial-standards): Reporting, documents, right of reply, analysis, opinion, corrections and the use of AI.
- [Methodology](https://thesignal24.com/methodology): Source hierarchy, verification labels, data integrity, legal status and the Hindi edition.
- [Editorial desk](https://thesignal24.com/authors/signal-24): The desk that signs off on every record and answers for corrections.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://thesignal24.com/sitemap.xml): Every public URL, with English and Hindi alternates where both exist.
- [Full reference text](https://thesignal24.com/llms-full.txt): The About, Standards and Methodology pages in full, in English and Hindi.
- [Search the evidence](https://thesignal24.com/evidence/search): Search articles, events and source documents as separate record types.
